title: Jayden Daniels: Brandon Aiyuk and I put the past behind us

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jayden Daniels: Brandon Aiyuk and I put the past behind us
sources.description: Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels and Brandon Aiyuk were once Arizona State teammates and close friends, but Aiyuk seemed to burn those bridges this year, when he posted several critical comments about Daniels on social media.
